IN.name: India

tax.creatorTax: GST 18% above ₹20L turnover. TDS 10% on brand deals. Advance tax quarterly.

IN.regulations: ASCI disclosure guidelines for paid content. COPPA applies for US viewers. No TikTok (banned).
IN.notes: Largest creator ecosystem by volume. WhatsApp #1 sharing platform. Regional language = deeper loyalty.

US.name: United States

tax.creatorTax: Self-employment tax 15.3%. Quarterly estimated tax. 1099 forms from platforms.
tax.deductions: Home office, equipment, software, travel, health insurance, retirement (SEP IRA)

US.regulations: FTC disclosure required (#ad, #sponsored). COPPA for kids content. Section 230 protections.
US.notes: Highest CPMs globally. Brands pay premium. Tax complexity high — get a CPA.

GB.name: United Kingdom

tax.creatorTax: Self-assessment tax return. Register as sole trader or Ltd company. VAT registration above £85K.
tax.deductions: Equipment, software, home office, travel, training

GB.regulations: ASA disclosure rules (strict). CAP Code for advertising. GDPR for data collection.
GB.notes: Strong brand deal market. ASA enforces disclosure aggressively.

CA.name: Canada

tax.creatorTax: GST/HST registration above C$30K. Quarterly installments if tax >C$3000.
tax.deductions: Equipment, internet, home office, vehicle for content, software

CA.regulations: Competition Bureau disclosure guidelines. PIPEDA for privacy. French language requirements in Quebec.
CA.notes: High CPMs. Bilingual market opportunity (English + French).

AU.name: Australia

tax.creatorTax: ABN required. GST registration above A$75K. BAS quarterly.
tax.deductions: Equipment, software, home office, travel, phone/internet

AU.regulations: ACCC disclosure requirements. Australian Consumer Law applies to product claims.
AU.notes: High CPMs. Small but affluent market. Strong fitness/outdoor niches.

DE.name: Germany

tax.creatorTax: Freelancer registration (Freiberufler). VAT 19%. Quarterly advance payments.

DE.regulations: Strict GDPR enforcement. TMG/MStV disclosure. Impressum required on all platforms.
DE.notes: Largest European market. German language content has captive audience. Strict advertising laws.

BR.name: Brazil

tax.creatorTax: MEI (Microempreendedor) for small creators. INSS social security contribution.

BR.regulations: CONAR advertising self-regulation. CDC consumer protection. Marco Civil for internet.
BR.notes: Massive audience. Portuguese content. WhatsApp dominant for sharing. Growing creator economy.

MX.name: Mexico

tax.creatorTax: RFC registration. Monthly ISR and IVA declarations. RESICO simplified regime for small creators.

MX.regulations: PROFECO consumer protection. Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales.
MX.notes: Largest Spanish-speaking YouTube market. Facebook still strong.

JP.name: Japan

tax.creatorTax: Blue/white tax return. Consumption tax 10% above ¥10M. Invoice system required.
tax.deductions: Equipment, studio, communication, travel, entertainment for content

JP.regulations: Act on Specified Commercial Transactions. Stealth marketing banned (Oct 2023).
JP.notes: Twitter/X is huge in Japan. VTuber culture. High ad spending. Japanese-only content performs best.

KR.name: South Korea

tax.creatorTax: Business income reporting. VAT 10%. Simplified tax for small creators.
tax.deductions: Equipment, studio, internet, content production costs

KR.regulations: Fair Trade Commission disclosure rules. Strict advertising standards.
KR.notes: K-beauty, K-pop, tech niches huge. Naver Blog still relevant. Short-form content dominant.

ID.name: Indonesia

tax.creatorTax: NPWP tax ID required. 0.5% final tax for micro businesses under IDR 500M/year.

ID.regulations: Ministry of Communication oversight. Content moderation laws.
ID.notes: 4th largest population. TikTok Shop massive. Muslim-majority = Ramadan content peaks.

PH.name: Philippines

tax.creatorTax: BIR registration. Percentage tax 3% for gross under ₱3M or VAT 12% above.

PH.regulations: DTI advertising standards. Data Privacy Act.
PH.notes: English-speaking. Facebook dominant. High social media usage per capita. Growing fast.

NG.name: Nigeria

tax.creatorTax: Company income tax if structured. VAT 7.5%. Register with FIRS.

NG.regulations: APCON advertising regulation. Nigeria Data Protection Act.
NG.notes: Largest African creator market. Nollywood/entertainment huge. Twitter culture strong.

AE.name: UAE

tax.creatorTax: Corporate tax 9% above AED 375K profit (if structured as business). VAT 5%.

AE.regulations: NMC National Media Council licensing for influencers. Strict content laws. No crypto/alcohol promotion.
AE.notes: Tax-free income. Luxury brands pay premium. Influencer licensing required. Snapchat big here.

SA.name: Saudi Arabia

tax.creatorTax: Freelance permit required (Marshad). VAT 15%.

SA.regulations: CITC content regulations. Vision 2030 entertainment push. Content restrictions apply.
SA.notes: Rapidly growing. Snapchat penetration highest globally. Entertainment sector booming.

SG.name: Singapore

tax.creatorTax: Register as sole proprietor or Pte Ltd. GST 9% above S$1M revenue.

SG.regulations: ASAS advertising standards. PDPA for data protection.
SG.notes: Small but affluent. Hub for Southeast Asian brand deals. LinkedIn strong for B2B.

TR.name: Turkey

tax.creatorTax: Stoppage tax on ad income. VAT 20%. Tax-free threshold for small earnings.

TR.regulations: BTK social media law. Advertising board (RK) guidelines. Content moderation requirements.
TR.notes: Large young population. Turkish-language content captive audience. E-commerce integration growing.

FR.name: France

tax.creatorTax: Micro-entrepreneur regime (auto-entrepreneur) for small creators. TVA 20%.
tax.deductions: Equipment, training, home office under micro-entrepreneur

FR.regulations: 2023 Influencer Law (strictest in world). Mandatory disclosure. Filter disclosure on edited images. CNIL/GDPR.
FR.notes: World's strictest influencer law. French content mandatory for French audience. Strong luxury brand market.

ZA.name: South Africa

tax.creatorTax: Register as provisional taxpayer. VAT 15% above R1M turnover.
tax.deductions: Equipment, internet, home office, travel for content

ZA.regulations: ASA advertising code. POPIA data protection. CPA consumer protection.
ZA.notes: Largest African English-speaking market. Growing creator economy. Multi-lingual content opportunity.

TH.name: Thailand

tax.creatorTax: Personal income tax on worldwide income. VAT 7% above ฿1.8M revenue.

TH.regulations: Computer Crime Act. Advertising content regulations. Platform-specific compliance.
TH.notes: LINE is major platform. Thai-language content dominates. Beauty and food niches huge.
